cases.name: query value changes preserve a parameter shape
cases.reference_policy: SMART groups by URL without query and content type, then compares parameter names with values replaced by a presence marker, when Burp exposes the same parsed parameter name.

cases.name: url encoded form values do not change the shape
cases.reference_policy: SMART replaces parsed parameter values with a presence marker; exact Burp extraction of this request body is not captured by this source-only corpus.

cases.name: nested JSON values retain their path shape
cases.reference_policy: The reference has a special recursive JSON path conversion before SMART and ignores values; its exact path serialization differs from this package.

cases.name: XML element and attribute names define the shape
cases.reference_policy: Burp content-type parsing is delegated to its SDK; this package's XML paths and element/attribute distinction are an explicit extension.

cases.name: same parameter name in query and form keeps distinct locations
cases.reference_policy: If Burp returns both IParameter entries, reference SMART flattens both into one JSON key by name and replaces both values with the same marker; this package intentionally includes location in shape identity.

cases.name: malformed JSON preserves query parsing and bypasses SMART state
cases.reference_policy: Malformed-body behavior depends on Burp parser output and is not specified by the reference source.
